## Review L15
### Turing-Gierer-Meinhardt models
### Local excitation, global inhibition

$$\begin{aligned}
\frac{\partial a}{\partial t} &= r_a + k_a \frac{a^2}{i} - \gamma_a a + D_a \frac{\partial^2 a}{\partial x^2} \\
\frac{\partial i}{\partial t} &= k_i a^2 - \gamma_i i + D_i \frac{\partial^2 i}{\partial x^2}
\end{aligned}$$

**variables**
a: concentration activator  
i: concentration inhibitor  
t: time  
x: position  

**constants (parameters)**
$r_a$: basal activator synthesis rate  
$k_a, k_i$: rate constant for synthesis  
$\gamma_a, \gamma_i$: decay rates  
$D_a, D_i$: diffusion constants  

---

$$\begin{aligned}
\frac{\partial a}{\partial t} &= r_a + k_a \frac{a^2}{i} - \gamma_a a + D_a \frac{\partial^2 a}{\partial x^2} \\
\frac{\partial i}{\partial t} &= k_i a^2 - \gamma_i i + D_i \frac{\partial^2 i}{\partial x^2}
\end{aligned}$$

$$\downarrow$$

choose dimensionless variable  
normalize 4 variables

$$\begin{aligned}
\frac{\partial A}{\partial \tau} &= 1 + R \frac{A^2}{I} - A + \frac{\partial^2 A}{\partial s^2} \\
\frac{\partial I}{\partial \tau} &= Q(A^2 - I) + P \frac{\partial^2 I}{\partial s^2}
\end{aligned}$$

$$\downarrow$$

**homogeneous solution**  
$\partial / \partial s = \partial / \partial t = 0$

$$\begin{aligned}
\bar{A} &= R + 1 \\
\bar{I} &= (R + 1)^2
\end{aligned}$$

---

**homogeneous solution**  
$\partial / \partial s = \partial / \partial t = 0$

---

### stability of homogeneous solution

$$\begin{bmatrix}
\frac{2R\bar{A}}{\bar{I}} - 1 & -\frac{R\bar{A}^2}{\bar{I}^2} \\
2\bar{A}Q & -Q
\end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix}
\frac{R-1}{R+1} & -\frac{R}{(R+1)^2} \\
2(R+1)Q & -Q
\end{bmatrix}$$

$$\text{trace} < 0$$
$$\text{det} > 0$$

$$\downarrow$$

$$\frac{R-1}{R+1} < Q$$
$$Q > 0$$

**inhomogeneous solution:**
$$A(s,\tau) = \bar{A} + A'(s,\tau)$$
$$I(s,\tau) = \bar{I} + I'(s,\tau)$$

---

**inhomogeneous solution**

$$A(s,\tau) = \bar{A} + A'(s,\tau)$$
$$I(s,\tau) = \bar{I} + I'(s,\tau)$$

$I'(s,\tau)$

---

$$A(s,\tau) = \bar{A} + A'(s,\tau)$$
$$I(s,\tau) = \bar{I} + I'(s,\tau)$$

$$\longrightarrow$$

$$\begin{aligned}
\frac{\partial A'}{\partial \tau} &= \frac{R-1}{R+1}A' - \frac{R}{(1+R)^2}I' + \frac{\partial^2 A'}{\partial s^2} \\
\frac{\partial I'}{\partial \tau} &= 2Q(1+R)A' - QI' + P \frac{\partial^2 I'}{\partial s^2}
\end{aligned}$$

**trial solution:**

$$A'(s,\tau) = \hat{A}(\tau)\cos(\frac{s}{\ell})$$
$$I'(s,\tau) = \hat{I}(\tau)\cos(\frac{s}{\ell})$$

---

$$A'(s,\tau) = \hat{A}(\tau)\cos(\frac{s}{\ell})$$
$$I'(s,\tau) = \hat{I}(\tau)\cos(\frac{s}{\ell})$$

$I'(s,\tau)$

$$A(s,\tau) = \bar{A} + A'(s,\tau)$$
$$I(s,\tau) = \bar{I} + I'(s,\tau)$$

---

$$A'(s,\tau) = \hat{A}(\tau)\cos(\frac{s}{\ell})$$
$$I'(s,\tau) = \hat{I}(\tau)\cos(\frac{s}{\ell})$$

$$\longrightarrow$$

$$\begin{aligned}
\frac{d\hat{A}}{d\tau} &= \left(\frac{R-1}{R+1} - \frac{1}{\ell^2}\right)\hat{A} - \frac{R}{(1+R)^2}\hat{I} \\
\frac{d\hat{I}}{d\tau} &= 2Q(1+R)\hat{A} - \left(Q + \frac{P}{\ell^2}\right)\hat{I}
\end{aligned}$$

**stability inhomogeneous solution**

$$-\left(\frac{R-1}{R+1} - \frac{1}{\ell^2}\right)\left(Q + \frac{P}{\ell^2}\right) + \frac{2QR}{1+R} > 0$$
$$Q + \frac{P}{\ell^2} - \left(\frac{R-1}{R+1} - \frac{1}{\ell^2}\right) < 0$$

$$\longrightarrow$$

$$\frac{Q}{P} > \frac{R-1}{R+1}$$

---

homogeneous stability:
$$Q > \frac{R-1}{R+1}$$

inhomogeneous stability:
$$\frac{Q}{P} > \frac{R-1}{R+1}$$

$I'(s,\tau)$

---

homogeneously stable: $\bar{I}$ relaxes back to previous value after small uniform disturbance

inhomogeneously stable: $I'$ relaxes back to $\bar{I}$ after small spatial disturbance
